title: Create a managed value
summary: Spring Framework: Create a managed value. Change the message bean.
introduction: @Bean marks a value that Spring creates. The context is a container that lets the program find that value.
learningObjectives: Create a managed value with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Create a managed value

blocks.text: Spring calls the @Bean method to create the String. getBean reads that managed value by its type.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Close the context when the program is finished.

seo.title: Spring Framework: Create a managed value
